label: Figure 21.4: Economic growth through an increase in potential output
alt: Panel (a): LRAS shifts right from LRAS1 to LRAS2, raising full-employment output from Yf1 to Yf2. Panel (b): the PPC shifts outward from PPC1 to PPC2, shown by two outward arrows.
caption: Panel (a): the LRAS curve itself shifts rightward from LRAS<sub>1</sub> to LRAS<sub>2</sub>, raising potential output from Y<sub>f1</sub> to Y<sub>f2</sub> against an unchanged AD<sub>1</sub>. Panel (b): the whole PPC bows further out, from PPC<sub>1</sub> to PPC<sub>2</sub> – the diagrammatic equivalent of the LRAS shift.
